texts.zh: 虽然成年后显现灵能较为罕见，但也不是前所未有。[psionic_leader.GetTitle][psionic_leader.GetName]最近展示的能力，我们就怀疑其本质是灵能。经过了全面的超能感知测试后，[psionic_leader.GetSheHe]被证实拥有4级灵能天赋。
texts.en: While it is rare for psionic powers to manifest after reaching adulthood, it is not unheard of. [psionic_leader.GetTitle] [psionic_leader.GetName] has recently been displaying abilities that were suspected to be psionic in nature. After undergoing a thorough ESP test, [psionic_leader.GetSheHe] [psionic_leader.GetHasHave] been identified as a class 4 psionic talent.

label.zh: 这项新能力很好地为我们所用。
label.en: These new abilities will serve us well.

texts.zh: 尽管较为罕见，灵能力有时候也会在此前不支持的硬件上自发部署。[psionic_leader.GetTitle][psionic_leader.GetName]最近就展现出了可以被归类为灵能的功能。在经过全面诊断之后，[psionic_leader.GetSheHe]被判定为拥有4级灵能天赋。
texts.en: Though rare, psionic abilities sometimes develop in units not previously known to support them. [psionic_leader.GetTitle] [psionic_leader.GetName] has recently displayed functionalities that could be classified as psionic. After undergoing thorough testing, [psionic_leader.GetSheHe] [psionic_leader.GetHasHave] been identified as a class 4 psionic unit.

label.zh: 这项新能力很好地为我们所用。
label.en: These new abilities will serve us well.

texts.zh: 我们新获得的力量影响与日俱增。我们的[GetBrainName]容器[psionic_leader.GetName]最近展现出了可以被归类为灵能的功能。在经过全面诊断之后，[psionic_leader.GetSheHe]被鉴定为4级[GetPsychicNoun]。
texts.en: The influence of our newfound powers grows with each day. The vessel of our [GetBrainName], [psionic_leader.GetName], has recently displayed abilities that could be classified as psionic. After undergoing thorough testing, [psionic_leader.GetSheHe] [psionic_leader.GetHasHave] been identified as a class 4 [GetPsychicNoun].

label.zh: 这项新能力很好地为我们所用。
label.en: These new abilities will serve us well.
